easyPrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to Wrathful Red Dragon.
description:
Deal damage to Wrathful Red Dragon.
Wrathful Red Dragon and Blazing Sunsteel trigger.
Resolve the Wrathful Red Dragon trigger, dealing damage to any target that isn't a Dragon.
Resolve the Blazing Sunsteel trigger, dealing damage to Wrathful Red Dragon.
Repeat from step 2.
